portal: https://www.lexus.com/My-Lexus/resources (Manuals & Resources -> Select new vehicle -> Select by year and model; no login needed in principle). Old secure.drivers.lexus.com no longer resolves.
notes: Owner's manuals, Navigation/Multimedia manuals and Warranty & Services Guides are listed by the page's call to https://vehicle-maintenance.orc.lexus.com/v2/vehicle/manual (needs an anonymous Azure AD token from https://oauth.orc.lexus.com/eos plus a reCAPTCHA token). From this network (Azerbaijan, CloudFront POP SOF50) that API answers 403 'FORBIDDEN ACCESS' even to a CORS preflight, so the browser shows 'There was a problem with displaying your manuals'. The documents themselves live on assets.sia.toyota.com/publications/en/{om-s|omnav-s|omms-s}/<CODE>/pdf/<CODE>.pdf (a different host from Toyota's assets.sipb.toyota.com, which returns the CloudFront country-block page); assets.sia.toyota.com returns S3 'AccessDenied' (403) for every URL tried, including URLs indexed by search, so it is treated as blocked/unverifiable. Nothing was bypassed (no proxy/VPN, no captcha solving). Owner's manual codes found by search (e.g. GX460: OM60J63U, OM60M73U; RX: OM0E041U, OM48C02U) carry no model year in their titles and were NOT mapped. Warranty and Services Guide URLs (L-MMS-<yy><model>) whose search titles state year+model are listed with verified=false. What IS reachable from here: www.lexus.com/rest/lexusdrivers/vehicledocs?year=Y&model=ES|RX|NX|GX (same-site REST used by the page; robots.txt allows) which returns Lexus Personalized Settings (LPS) forms and the multi-model Technology Quick Guide on www.lexus.com/content/dam/lexus/drivers/... - these are listed (verified, how=api) but are not owner's manuals; 204 = no docs for that model-year. Two LPS URLs returned by the API are dead (404): 2014 ES 350 and 2019 ES 350. To obtain the owner's manuals, run the same portal from a US network (or obtain the files manually) - out of scope here.
